subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: Should the intentional removal of the private qa-matrix workspace package and its pnpm lockfile importer be authorized for head 2d7a4037cf5614eadcc240aabee6360ec6bbf7dd?
rationale: The diff is consistent with the ownership cleanup and adds no dependency, but repository policy deliberately requires an administrator or security owner to authorize dependency-graph changes for the exact head.

options.title: Authorize the deletion
options.body: Approve the exact-head dependency change after confirming that QA Lab now owns every required Matrix command and runtime path.

options.title: Defer until the parent lands
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103604 to land, then rebase and authorize the resulting exact head.

options.title: Retain the temporary package
options.body: Reject the removal and keep qa-matrix as a separate compatibility package, accepting continued duplicate ownership and inventory complexity.

recommendation.title: Authorize the deletion
recommendation.body: Approve the exact-head dependency change after confirming that QA Lab now owns every required Matrix command and runtime path.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa owns the consolidation stack and prior merged QA Lab infrastructure, so they are best positioned to coordinate the required administrator or security approval.
